items.title: 68190_Samuel
items.q: The fellow that influenced me was a guy that was playing with Benny Moten, a guy called Banjo Joe.

ctx.x: Well, I'm going to ask you a question. Who influenced you on banjo and guitar playing; through records and who's your favorite?
The fellow that influenced me was a guy that was playing with Benny Moten, a guy called Banjo Joe.
